originality.rationale: Targeted searches for adjacency star evolution algebras, orthogonal/symplectic totally isotropic subspaces and subalgebra dimension polynomials were compared by mathematical implication with three inspected primary full texts. The 2021 graph algebra source provides the underlying algebra; the 2017 paper concerns isomorphisms/isotopy; the 2016 paper concerns subalgebra definitions, ideals and decomposition, and does not state this cubic-root/polar-space census. Published results about bilinear nonassociative algebras or the evolution dimension of a ring concern different products/invariants. No found theorem implies the three disjoint classes or all coefficients. Unobserved prior equivalences remain possible; the literature search is not itself a proof of originality.
residual_risks: A specialized unpublished or obscure classification could use graph algebra, nonassociative bilinear form or polar-space language not indexed under evolution-algebra subalgebras.
The full text of the 2014 nilpotent evolution-subalgebra paper was inaccessible; its abstract makes direct domination unlikely but does not establish whole-document noncoverage.

value.rationale: All multiplication-closed embedded subalgebras are naturally enumerated for every adjacency-defined finite star with invertible leaf count. The formula unifies ordinary Gaussian Grassmannians, finite orthogonal or symplectic isotropic Grassmannians and cube-root arithmetic, producing a genuine field-extension/cubic-residue transition and examples with no one-dimensional nonzero subalgebras. It is a complete structural invariant for an infinite family, not a small computational example or a mere notation change.
